description: Hand over a user's situation and get the best-matched picks from a Top 11 list. Describe the problem in plain language (e.g. 'startup that needs to get fundraise-ready' or 'reduce no-shows for a dental practice'); optionally add a persona/segment, a budget band ($, $$, $$$), and a max_risk ceiling to exclude firms with higher verified public risk signals. No slug needed. Top 11 auto-picks the most relevant list. Returns the top matches with the reason each was chosen and each pick's risk level.

max_risk.description: Optional. Exclude firms whose verified public risk signals exceed this level.

problem.description: The specific problem or need the user wants solved.

segment.description: Optional persona or vertical, e.g. 'seed-stage SaaS', 'bootstrapped business'.

slug.description: Optional list slug. Defaults to the most relevant published list.

name: recommend
